# TDD and Testing Checklist: Agentic Software Engineering System: URL Shortener

**Purpose**: Validate that test-first order, test coverage of requirements, and test evidence rules are defined
**Created**: 2026-10-17
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.
**Legend**: `[M]` mandatory (a constitution MUST, an approved requirement, or an approved decision); `[O]` optional enhancement or backlog boundary. `G0` is evaluable now against the approved specification, plan, ADRs, and contracts; `G1` is evaluable after `/speckit-tasks` and `/speckit-analyze`, before implementation. `{Detects: ...}` links an item to a failure pattern in the [README](README.md) detection matrix. Dimension tags: Completeness, Clarity, Consistency, Measurability, Coverage, Traceability, Edge Case, Assumption, Conflict, Gap.
## Order of Work and Red Evidence

- [ ] CHK001 - Is the order approved specification, plan, tasks, analysis, failing test, implementation required, with a failure when implementation precedes any of them? [Measurability, Constitution I, IV, Plan §7] [M, G0] {Detects: implementation-before-spec-or-tests}
- [ ] CHK002 - Is the red step defined (fails for the expected reason, recorded output, recorded before the implementing commit)? [Clarity, Constitution IV, POL-TEST-001, ADR-012] [M, G0] {Detects: implementation-before-spec-or-tests}
- [ ] CHK003 - Are exceptions to red-first limited, recorded, and approved? [Coverage, Testing §1] [M, G0]

## Coverage of Requirements

- [ ] CHK004 - Are all required test categories defined with scope and requirement mapping? [Completeness, Testing §3, Constitution IV] [M, G0]
- [ ] CHK005 - Is each FR mapped to a category and each NAC required to have a negative test? [Coverage, Testing §9, Spec FR-001..FR-133] [M, G0]
- [ ] CHK006 - Is the tests-for-every-FR gate defined with a mechanism (title tags, reporter) and a rule that skipped tests do not count? [Measurability, ADR-012, Spec DEC-052] [M, G0]
- [ ] CHK007 - Are failure-path tests defined for retry bounds, timeouts, fallback never lowering a gate, failed compensation, safe-stop terminality, resume without duplicates, and replan of only affected work? [Coverage, Testing §3] [M, G0]
- [ ] CHK008 - Are concurrency tests defined deterministically (barriers, repeated runs, real database, pool larger than one, no sleeps)? [Clarity, Testing §4.1, Spec DEC-113] [M, G0]
- [ ] CHK009 - Is the simulated clock required for time-dependent tests, with direct clock calls rejected? [Measurability, ADR-010] [M, G0]
- [ ] CHK010 - Are security tests defined for AB-01..AB-12 and TH-01..TH-16? [Coverage, Security §3.4, §4.2] [M, G0]
- [ ] CHK011 - Are contract tests defined for every documented error code and for strict rejection of unknown fields (no stripping, no coercion)? [Completeness, ADR-002, Contracts README CV-04] [M, G0]
- [ ] CHK012 - Are Redis-down, stale-cache, and PostgreSQL-only-mode tests defined? [Coverage, Testing §4.1a, ADR-015] [M, G0]
- [ ] CHK013 - Are scans defined as tests with negative controls (seeded fake secret, vulnerable-dependency fixture)? [Coverage, ADR-012] [M, G0]

## Gates, Data, and Evidence

- [ ] CHK014 - Are coverage and quality gates quantified (PVT-012) and their failure effect defined? [Measurability, Spec PVT-012] [M, G0]
- [ ] CHK015 - Are test data and fixtures defined so tests depend only on declared services? [Completeness, Testing §5] [M, G0]
- [ ] CHK016 - Must test results used as evidence be real executions with environment and time, never pasted or fabricated? [Coverage, Spec Evidence Catalogue EV-TEST, Constitution X] [M, G0] {Detects: fabricated-results}
- [ ] CHK017 - Is the Node version used for tests recorded as evidence (tested on 24; 20 and 22 declared but untested) so support claims are not overstated? [Clarity, Spec DEC-071] [M, G0] {Detects: unsupported-completion-claims}
- [ ] CHK018 - Does tasks.md (once generated) place a test task before each implementation task with a cited requirement? [Traceability, Constitution IV] [M, G1] {Detects: implementation-before-spec-or-tests}
- [ ] CHK019 - Is mutation testing labelled backlog? [Coverage, Plan §6.1 BL-08] [O, G0]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- Items marked `[Gap]` or `[Conflict]` name a place where the current documents are silent or disagree; they are findings for the reviewer to resolve, not pre-judged results
- Add comments or findings inline
- Items are numbered sequentially within this file (`CHK001` onward); cite them as `<file>:CHKnnn`
